av_event.line_text: Bianca: I can't remember the name, it's got like an orange label. I use Vinted a lot as well. People sell stuff they've only opened once.
av_event.what: A young man in a dark work polo, sleepy-looking, walks across the room behind Bianca, unplugs the phone charger trailing over the settee arm and walks back out of frame. Bianca doesn't turn round and keeps talking.

text:
B: Hi, can you hear me?
A: Yeah. Hiya.
B: Jasmine. I'm in Plymouth.
A: Bianca. Wolverhampton.
B: What do you do, Bianca?
A: Erm, I'm at uni. Accounting and Finance, second year.
B: Oh, good. I need more accountants in my life. I've got two bubble tea shops and I do the books myself in Xero.
A: Oh, we did Xero in a module last term. It's alright actually. Easier than Sage.
B: Much easier. My accountant still charges me like I'm making it hard for him, though.
A: That's kind of what I want to be, to be honest. The one charging.
B: Good. That's the right attitude. Where do you want to work?
A: Birmingham, hopefully. I'm applying for placements at the mid-size firms. Then ACCA. I want to be earning properly by like twenty-five. Actual money, do you know what I mean.
B: You will. Accountants always have work, that's why I like them. Boring is good, you know. Boring pays.
A: Yeah, that's literally what I told my mum.
A: How did you get two shops, though? Like, at your age.
B: Savings, a loan from my dad, and my partner signed as guarantor. First one in 2019, second in 2022. My dad still talks about the loan like he owns the business. Every phone call it's "how's my shop?" It's not your shop, I paid you back.
A: That's so annoying.
B: It is. Anyway. What do you do when you're not studying?
A: Gym, mostly. Just the treadmill with my headphones in. I like that nobody talks to you.
B: Same, exactly the same. If someone tries to chat to me at PureGym I just point at my earphones.
A: Yeah. And TV. Reality stuff. I'm on the new Married at First Sight Australia.
B: Oh my God, the Australian one is the best one. The British one is so boring compared.
A: The Australian ones are proper unhinged.
B: Totally. Do you do skincare? You look like you do skincare.
A: Yeah, a bit. I got this vitamin C serum half price last week off a discount code. Some Korean brand.
B: Which one? I buy mostly Korean and Japanese. Half price is good.
A: I can't remember the name, it's got like an orange label. I use Vinted a lot as well. People sell stuff they've only opened once.
B: I sell on Vinted! I sold a coat last month for more than I paid. Forty-five pounds, and I got it for thirty in a sale.
A: That's profit, that is.
B: That's what I said to Tom. He said I should declare it.
A: Nobody declares Vinted, do you know what I mean.
B: Exactly, lah. Don't tell my accountant.
A: I won't. Not yet, anyway.
